_comment: Single source of truth for the press page. Edit this file, then run
to render the cards into press.html.
RULES FOR THIS FILE, which matter more than usual because the content is
1. Every 'quote' is VERBATIM from the article at 'url'. Not a paraphrase,
not a tidied version, not a sentence assembled from two places. Each one
below was checked by loading the live article and asserting the string
appears in the page text character for character (allowing only for
2. A quote is a COMPLETE sentence. A fragment cut to fit is a misquote.
3. No quote, no problem: omit the field and the card renders as a citation
with a link. Never invent one to fill the gap.
4. Every 'url' has been fetched and confirmed to load and to be about this
property. Several URLs on the old version of this page did not: two
redirected to unrelated articles (a football report and a boxing
preview) because their article IDs were invented, and nine returned 404.
Do not add a URL that has not been opened.
'checked' is when the whole set was last verified end to end.

oxford.heading: Oxfordshire in print
oxford.intro: The Narnia-inspired treehouse, the cave hideaway and the woodland around them.

items.headline: My visit to the Oxfordshire woodland that inspired Narnia
items.quote: Cedar Hollow is a treehouse sleeping four, with a circular main room that seems a lot larger inside than out; there’s curiously carved furniture, medieval arched windows and, naturally, a magic wardrobe.

items.headline: 11 of the best Airbnbs in Oxford
items.quote: This extraordinary place takes its inspiration from his beloved Narnia books, and sets out to recreate the home of Mr Tumnus, the faun who befriends the main characters.

items.headline: Narnia in Oxfordshire: The doctor, the treehouse and the wardrobe
items.quote: Cedar Hollow is inspired by C.S Lewis' Chronicles of Narnia and even features the eponymous wardrobe from the first book in the series.

items.headline: Cool stay of the week: a fairytale treehouse in the Oxfordshire woodlands
items.quote: Perched among the canopy of the majestic Shotover Country Park, Cedar Hollow Treehouse is the perfect long weekend escape.

items.headline: The best treehouse stays in the UK – bookable on Airbnb
items.quote: This magical treehouse Airbnb borders CS Lewis's old garden – a great place for literature fans and budding writers.

items.headline: I built ‘Britain’s best treehouse’ inspired by fantasy world with ‘magic’ wardrobe
items.quote: Cedar Hollow treehouse is inspired by The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe and is just two doors down from where famous author Lewis lived.

items.headline: Inside the whimsical treehouse Adrienne and Matt stayed in on MAFS UK
items.quote: The treehouse is set in Shotover Country Park in Oxford and is themed around Narnia.

items.headline: Inside Amber Davies and boyfriend Nick Kyriacou's romantic treehouse retreat
items.quote: In a clip uploaded to her Instagram story, the musical theatre actress gave a full tour of the Cedar Hollow retreat nestled in the Oxfordshire woodland.

items.headline: The Narnia-inspired treehouse hidden in Shotover Country Park
items.quote: Inspired by C.S Lewis' world of Narnia, the treehouse is a memorable stay, blending in with the nature surrounding it.

items.headline: This Narnia-themed treehouse near London is the perfect staycation
items.quote: Cedar Hollow Treehouse is nestled in the magical Oxfordshire woodlands, hidden in Shotover Country Park, which boasts over 100 acres of ever-changing colours, wildlife, and mystique.

items.headline: Inside Narnia-themed treehouse that features its own ‘magic’ wardrobe
items.quote: The impressive property comes complete with a magic wardrobe door that 'transports' visitors straight into the countryside.

items.headline: Narnia themed treehouse built next to C.S. Lewis’ home features magic wardrobe
items.quote: The property in Oxford, England, features rooms inspired by the beavers’ den and Mr. Tumnus’s cave from the Narnia books written by C.S. Lewis.

items.headline: A storybook-themed stay in the UK Narnia fans will love
items.quote: Entering Cedar Hollow Treehouse is like stepping into a fairytale.

dorset.heading: Dorset in print
dorset.intro: The Woodsman's Treehouse and the retreats that followed it.
